name: Intercultural Encounters
description:
What does “international” really mean? Beyond stereotypes, we can discover both fascinating diversity and surprising similarities. 
In this seminar, German and international students come together to learn, exchange, and experience cultural diversity in an open and authentic way. Workshops, cultural events, and group projects provide space to explore differences, reflect on them, and build common ground. 
  
Participants strengthen their intercultural sensitivity, learn to navigate challenges in diverse teams, and develop skills for respectful and constructive collaboration. 

  
Key questions we will explore include: 
•	How do unconscious biases and stereotypes shape perception and interaction? 
•	How can I deal with irritating situations in intercultural settings? 
•	How do people build trust and give constructive feedback? 
•	What skills are crucial for intercultural teamwork?
